title: Determine range of values
text: Angles in the fourth quadrant have infinitely many possible descriptions. We might have (3pi)/2< $$\theta$$ <2pi, or we might have (3pi)/2+2pik< $$\theta$$ <2pi+2pik for $$k$$ some integer value. This is because we could wind any number of times around the circle first before landing at the angle.

title: Write in terms of $$2\pi$$
text: Look at each angle and express in terms of $$2\pi k$$ for some $$k.$$
